previews.title: chore(shortcuts): target Android 14 like DroidDeck so Play Protect does not block the companion
previews.summary:
• Target: shortcuts targets 34. Its versionCode goes from 1 to 2, so DroidDeck replaces an installed v1 the next time System keys is turned on.
• <queries> entry: the companion declares <queries> for com.droiddeck.shortcuts.RELAY. From targetSdk 30, Android hides other apps' services from queryIntentServices/bindService unless the app declares them. Without the entry, the companion would find no DroidDeck relay and System keys would silently do nothing.
• Receiver flag: the package-added receiver is registered with RECEIVERNOTEXPORTED on Android 13+. It only receives system broadcasts, which still arrive with that flag.
previews.author: xXJSONDeruloXx

previews.title: feat(xbox): Xbox sign-in in the same frame as the other stores
previews.summary: The Xbox sign-in window looked nothing like the other stores' sign-in: plain white status text, a full-width grey CLOSE button and a black background. When its helper failed to start, it reported only the exception class ("Failed while starting the Xbox helper: IOException"), so sign-in failure reports could not be told apart.

previews.summary: Updates MaliBridge from v0.5.4.2 to MaliBridge v0.5.5.4, tested in DroidDeck on my Galaxy Tab S10+. Steam comes up through the bridge and the RE6 benchmark runs at about 25 fps.

previews.title: ci: reclaim root-owned workspace files before checkout on self-hosted runners
previews.summary: Main run 43886987517 was cancelled on droiddeck-runner-2 during the x86 preloads docker run, before the recipe's sudo chown. The root-owned linuxfs/i386 and linuxfs/x8664 directories it left made actions/checkout fail on that runner in every later run (43887291871 both attempts).
previews.author: xXJSONDeruloXx

previews.title: feat(display): black frame insertion on 100 Hz and faster screens
previews.summary: Black frame insertion (BFI), requested in the feature-request threads "BFI/Black frame insertion" and "Any chance go get Bfi/Shaderbeam?". This is the first version: classic BFI only. Variable MPRT, rolling scan and LCD phase swap are left for later.

previews.title: fix(preload): Windows games run from noexec shared storage under every Proton
previews.summary: A Windows game installed to a custom folder on Android shared storage (for example Games/EA under internal storage, seen in the guest as /mnt/droiddeck-sd/Games/EA) crashes right after launch, while the same game in the default Games/Stores location works. Reported on a REDMAGIC Astra II (0.7.1) with two EA games, running Valve's Proton Experimental ARM64.
previews.author: maxjivi05

previews.title: fix(session): default eligible Steam interfaces to GPU compositing
previews.summary: Eligible open-driver sessions default Steam web compositing to software. SessionPrefs.kt:898 returns false for an unset preference; SessionService.kt:970-977 then exports BLSTEAMSOFTCOMPOSITING=1. The session script adds -cef-disable-gpu-compositing while retaining GPU raster and ANGLE Vulkan.
previews.author: maxjivi05

previews.author: maxjivi05

previews.title: fix(steam): re-apply saved QAM scaling mode and filter at game start
previews.summary: After a restart, Steam shows the saved Scaling Mode/Filter in the QAM (e.g. Fill) but does not write GAMESCOPENEWSCALINGSCALER/FILTER to gamescope until the slider is moved, so the game stays on Auto and looks like Fit.

previews.title: feat(agent): keep Claude Code open between turns so background tasks can wake it
previews.summary: Background tasks started by the agent never reported back on their own: each message ran a fresh claude -p with stdin closed, so the process exited at the end of the turn and the task-notification waited for the user's next message.
previews.author: xXJSONDeruloXx

previews.title: fix(desktop): serve PipeWire in Desktop mode so screen capture works
previews.summary: Desktop mode launches Plasma without the bundled PipeWire service. Sunshine's portal remote desktop request fails (RemoteDesktop Start failed with response code: 2), leaving streaming clients without a capturable display.
previews.author: xXJSONDeruloXx

previews.title: feat(boot-movie): add a Shuffle switch backed by Steam's startup movie shuffle setting
previews.summary: Settings > Boot movie > Installed only lets one movie be picked. Steam can shuffle its startup movies (client setting startupmovieshuffle, read by its UI in steamui/sp.js), but DroidDeck offered no way to turn that on, so the same movie played every start.
previews.author: xXJSONDeruloXx

previews.title: perf(turnip): system-memory rendering for games and apps by default
previews.summary: The "Turnip: sysmem rendering" setting (on by default) only reached the Steam client. Games got DROIDDECKGAMETUDEBUG empty unless the runtime driver was the 710-720 build, so droiddeck-game-env removed TUDEBUG and Turnip chose tile (GMEM) or system-memory rendering per pass. #1188 set up that split.
previews.author: maxjivi05

previews.title: fix(game-env): turn off Proton's tabtip unless the Steam keyboard is enabled
previews.summary: Games that answer UI Automation (Godot 4.5 games, with AccessKit linked in) crash a few seconds after their window appears, on some launches but not all. Reported on Discord (vivo I2501, Adreno 840, DroidDeck 0.7.1, Proton Experimental ARM64 11.0-20261105c), with the same crash in #678 and in the earlier report behind the closed PR #205.
previews.author: maxjivi05

previews.title: fix(input): stop controller rumble when the game that started it is gone
previews.summary: When a Proton game crashes while it's rumbling, the phone (or controller) keeps vibrating in a loop until you stop the whole session. It happens to me every time Forza Horizon 4 crashes on my OnePlus 13s.
previews.author: Tapuuk

previews.title: fix(ci): no 404 window when a test build is replaced; merged PRs keep their build until Preview has it
previews.summary: pr-release-publish deleted the previous push's APK in the same step that uploaded the new one. The catalog was only regenerated afterwards, in a separate job. An app reading the old catalog during that window got a 404, which showed up as Download failed. This happened on #2626.
previews.author: xXJSONDeruloXx

previews.title: fix(game-env): only patch Death Stranding's allocator for Death Stranding's app id

previews.title: perf(session): keep a game that holds a steady pace off the fastest cores
previews.summary: A game that busy-waits for its own frame cap looks like a full core of demand to the scheduler, so its main thread migrates to the fastest core and stays there even when it only needs a fraction of it. On an AYANEO Pocket FIT Elite (8 Elite), Sonic Mania's main menu kept its main thread on cpu7 (4.32 GHz, prime) at 60 fps and drew over 11 W.
previews.author: xXJSONDeruloXx

tests.title: fix(gog): resolve exact-path depot overlays before validation

tests.author: maxjivi05

tests.author: maxjivi05

A loopback redirect from Chrome does not work: after the login form, Epic's account page routes the launcher client (34a02cf8…) to /id/login/welcome, which waits for the desktop launcher's JS bridge (ue.signinprompt

tests.summary: A Galaxy A56 (Xclipse 540) still lags in Steam's interface after #2660. Its log picks the system driver (session.log:7) and launches Steam with -cef-disable-gpu-compositing (session.log:160,166). tests.title: feat: Trinkets tab with a Bluetooth controller mode
tests.summary: Adds a Trinkets tab to the rail. Its first entry turns the device into a Bluetooth gamepad for another PC, phone or handheld.
tests.author: xXJSONDeruloXx

tests.title: feat(game-env): let a game override the session locale
tests.summary: Games that ship several languages and take theirs from the Windows locale could not be given one of their own: every title in a session ran in the same locale. A game now carries a locale picked from the app's own language list, and the launch sets LANG to it before Wine starts, so the game's language and code page follow the game instead of the session.
tests.author: kingokksa

tests.title: feat(session): run every session in the language the app is set to
tests.summary: Windows games came up in English whatever language the app was set to, although the translations are usually in the package. Only the desktop session used the app language, every other mode ran with LANG=C.UTF-8, and Windows keeps the preferred UI languages a prefix was created with.
tests.author: kingokksa

tests.title: fix(session): report the CPU cache sizes the x86 CPUID reports to Windows programs
tests.summary: A title that checks its CPU cache sizes stops at startup with ASSERT FAILURE: ( mL2CacheSize == -1 ) || ( staticcast< unsigned int >( mL2CacheSize ) == GEARKB( L2Unified ) ) (platform.cpp(334)), followed by an unhandled breakpoint (reporter's 0.7.1 session log, OnePlus CPH2653 / SM8750).
tests.author: xXJSONDeruloXx

tests.title: fix(input): ignore touchpad taps while an on-screen mouse button is shown
tests.summary: With a mouse button on the on-screen controls, accidental taps on the game screen still click through the touchpad route, so players get stray clicks next to the buttons (reported in #support on a RedMagic 11S Pro).
tests.author: xXJSONDeruloXx

tests.title: fix(gog): check space for the extracted install before downloading an offline installer
tests.summary: GOG installs that fall back to the offline installer fail with "The installer could not be extracted (innoextract exit 2)". Reports: Fallout: London One-click Edition on a Galaxy S26 Ultra, 0.7.1 (Discord message 1569741537204502609) and CrossCode (message 1569067037160898712, no logs attached).
tests.author: xXJSONDeruloXx

tests.title: feat(desktop): sync clipboard text to Android
tests.summary: Related to #2077. That issue was closed because Android clipboard sync already worked for game sessions; it did not cover Desktop mode.
tests.author: xXJSONDeruloXx

tests.title: feat(input): hold and double-tap actions, autofire, and physical button bindings for screen keys
tests.summary: Screen keys only supported a single tap action, and physical (back) buttons took one fixed binding. There was no way to express hold, double-tap or autofire semantics on either.
tests.author: kingokksa

tests.title: fix(gamescope): release Vulkan resources before exit
tests.summary: Gamescope faults with SIGSEGV after its primary child exits in the Desktop window path. Logs show the same shutdown sequence for unrelated Windows programs on Adreno 735 and Adreno 840 devices. The Desktop-mode report is from Xiaomi / Adreno 735 (DroidDeck 0.7.1). A failed touchup was never retried and later launches reported touchup=done. tests.author: xXJSONDeruloXx

tests.title: fix(components): install the real ARM64 Visual C++ runtime instead of registry entries
tests.summary: Enabling the Visual C++ 2015-2022 ARM64 component only wrote VC\Runtimes\arm64 registry values (WinComponents.builtInArm64Runtime). No runtime binaries were supplied, so an ARM64 program that needs them still hit the missing-runtime dialog (#2412). The package engine also dropped every ARM64 MSI (SKIPPLATFORMS in droiddeck-msi-install), so pointing the component at the real redistributabl
tests.author: xXJSONDeruloXx

tests.title: feat: emulate LSE atomics so the Steam client starts on ARMv8.0 CPUs
tests.summary: Valve's arm64 Steam client builds after April 15 2026 use ARMv8.1 LSE atomics (ldaddal, casal, swp), so the client dies with SIGILL and a black screen on ARMv8.0 CPUs: Cortex-A53/A57/A72/A73, e.g. the Snapdragon 685 in #380. Valve has not answered ValveSoftware/steam-for-linux#13288. Pinning an old client doesn't stick because it self-updates.
tests.author: xXJSONDeruloXx

tests.title: feat: add community on-screen controls
tests.summary: Adds Community controls to controller settings with source selection, searchable packs and previews, local ZIP import/export, and per-game screen profiles.
tests.author: xXJSONDeruloXx

tests.title: fix: the virtual pads reach non-Steam programs, where udev is resolved through dlsym
tests.summary: Outside Steam the pads were invisible: Firefox and Chromium load libudev with dlopen and look the symbols up with dlsym, which skips interposition, so the browser found no pad even though the virtual device was there. SDL2 (SDLudev.c) and hidapi's Linux backend take the same route, so any program outside Steam that enumerates udev input devices missed them too.
tests.author: kingokksa

tests.title: fix(epic): hand Epic's terms step to the browser instead of looping the sign-in
tests.summary: Epic sign-in keeps restarting for accounts with a pending terms step (a new account created at sign-in, or updated terms). Epic's redirect page then returns errors.com.epicgames.oauth.correctiveactionrequired with correctiveAction PRIVACYPOLICYACCEPTANCE or EULAACCEPTANCE instead of an authorization code (reporter screenshots in the Discord bug thread). EpicLogin.finish finds no cod
tests.author: xXJSONDeruloXx

tests.title: fix(retroarch): use the packaged assets, cores and core info paths
tests.summary: RetroArch showed black icons, "No Core," and "Fetching core list..." droiddeck-pad-defaults creates retroarch.cfg before the first run, so the packaged RetroArch system config is not loaded. RetroArch can then use empty per-user asset and core paths instead of the paths containing the packaged files. On a Retroid Pocket Duo, pointing the config at the packaged paths restored the icons.
tests.author: xXJSONDeruloXx

tests.title: fix(hud): keep floating HUD widths stable as readings change
tests.summary: Numeric readings changing digit count could change the width of floating performance HUDs and resize their outline, especially in Mega mode.
tests.author: KeegantheVeganat0r

tests.title: feat(stores): editable launch options for EA store games
tests.summary: Games installed from the EA Store had no way to take launch arguments. The Launch tab only offered launch options for Steam and plain added games, the listing dropped any saved value for store games, and the generated EA launcher ignored arguments passed by the Steam shortcut. Some titles need an executable flag to start or run correctly.

tests.title: feat: Performance boost switch for any phone, with Samsung clock floors and a boost report
tests.summary: A Boost group in Settings → Performance: a switch that asks the phone for more speed while a game falls behind, a log of what it did, and a test mode that measures whether it helps. This PR is mainly for testers: no frame-rate gain has been measured yet.

tests.title: fix: a recreated launcher screen keeps running installs and save work busy
tests.summary: After the launcher screen is recreated (a language change, a settings reset, or a configuration change it doesn't handle), work that is still running stays marked busy. It is no longer possible to start a session or remove the Linux runtime while that work is writing into it.
